options.name: delimiter
options.description: A one-character string used to separate fields. When using this parameter, you change the default value used by O(dialect). The default value depends on the dialect used.

options.name: dialect
options.description: The CSV dialect to use when parsing the CSV file. Possible values include V(excel), V(excel-tab) or V(unix).

options.name: fieldnames
options.description: A list of field names for every column. This is needed if the CSV does not have a header.

options.name: key
options.description: The column name used as a key for the resulting dictionary. If O(key) is unset, the module returns a list of dictionaries, where each dictionary is a row in the CSV file.

options.name: path
options.description: The CSV filename to read data from.

options.name: skipinitialspace
options.description: Whether to ignore any whitespaces immediately following the delimiter. When using this parameter, you change the default value used by O(dialect). The default value depends on the dialect used.

options.name: strict
options.description: Whether to raise an exception on bad CSV input. When using this parameter, you change the default value used by O(dialect). The default value depends on the dialect used.

options.name: unique
options.description: Whether the O(key) used is expected to be unique.
